svg.title: Reforestation Planning Map pipeline
svg.desc: Six factors (burn severity, canopy loss, time since event, seed-source distance, slope, roads) feed a score for every 30 m cell; cells are grouped into planting zones that are served to a map. 851 zones (~72,000 acres) in Plumas National Forest, CA · 6 zones after Hurricane Helene, SC. scoring weights are heuristics, not yet validated.
